Modal

弹出模态框，常用于消息提示、消息确认，支持组件调用（最低版本：25.12.0）

代码演示

maml


<view>
  <maui-modal title='基础弹窗' content='测试内容' visible="{{currentModal === 'modal1'}}" primaryButtonText='主按钮文本'
              bindclose='handleClose' bindprimaryButtonTap='primaryButtonTap'></maui-modal>
  <maui-modal content='测试内容(无标题)' visible="{{currentModal === 'modal2'}}" primaryButtonText='确认'
              bindclose='handleClose' bindprimaryButtonTap='primaryButtonTap'></maui-modal>
  <maui-modal title='基础弹窗' content='测试内容(双按钮横向排列)' visible="{{currentModal === 'modal3'}}"
              bindclose='handleClose' bindprimaryButtonTap='primaryButtonTap' primaryButtonText='主要按钮'
              secondaryButtonText='辅助' bindsecondaryButtonTap='secondaryButtonTap'></maui-modal>
  <maui-modal title='基础弹窗' content='测试内容(带辅助和取消按钮)' visible="{{currentModal === 'modal4'}}"
              primaryButtonText='主按钮' secondaryButtonText='辅助' cancelButtonText='取消' bindclose='handleClose'
              bindcancelButtonTap='cancelButtonTap' bindprimaryButtonTap='primaryButtonTap'
              bindsecondaryButtonTap='secondaryButtonTap'></maui-modal>

  <maui-modal title='强调模式' content='测试内容' visible="{{currentModal === 'modal5'}}" primaryButtonText='主按钮文本'
              bindclose='handleClose' bindprimaryButtonTap='primaryButtonTap' type='focus'></maui-modal>
  <maui-modal title='强调模式' content='测试内容(双按钮横向排列)' visible="{{currentModal === 'modal6'}}"
              bindclose='handleClose' bindprimaryButtonTap='primaryButtonTap' primaryButtonText='主要按钮'
              secondaryButtonText='辅助' bindsecondaryButtonTap='secondaryButtonTap' type='focus'></maui-modal>
  <maui-modal title='强调模式' content='测试内容(带辅助和取消按钮)' visible="{{currentModal === 'modal7'}}"
              primaryButtonText='主按钮' secondaryButtonText='辅助' cancelButtonText='取消' bindclose='handleClose'
              bindcancelButtonTap='cancelButtonTap' bindprimaryButtonTap='primaryButtonTap'
              bindsecondaryButtonTap='secondaryButtonTap' type='focus'></maui-modal>
  <maui-modal title='强调模式' content='测试内容(可关闭)' visible="{{currentModal === 'modal8'}}"
              primaryButtonText='主按钮文本' bindclose='handleClose' bindprimaryButtonTap='primaryButtonTap'
              type='focus' closable></maui-modal>

  <maui-modal title='自定义Modal' content='DIY主按钮' visible="{{currentModal === 'modalDIYPrimary'}}"
              primaryButtonText='主按钮文本' bindclose='handleClose' bindprimaryButtonTap='primaryButtonTap'
              primaryButtonStyle='color: red'></maui-modal>
  <maui-modal title='自定义Modal' visible="{{currentModal === 'modalDIYContent'}}" primaryButtonText='主按钮文本'
              bindclose='handleClose' bindprimaryButtonTap='primaryButtonTap'>
    <button>DIY主内容为按钮</button>
  </maui-modal>

  <maui-cell-group title='基础用法'>
    <maui-cell title='基础弹窗' bindclick='showModal' value='>' data-modal-value='modal1' />
    <maui-cell title='提示弹窗(无标题)' bindclick='showModal' value='>' data-modal-value='modal2' />
    <maui-cell title='双按钮弹窗' bindclick='showModal' value='>' data-modal-value='modal3' />
    <maui-cell title='三按钮弹窗' bindclick='showModal' value='>' data-modal-value='modal4' />
  </maui-cell-group>

  <maui-cell-group title='强调模式'>
    <maui-cell title='只有主按钮' bindclick='showModal' value='>' data-modal-value='modal5' />
    <maui-cell title='带辅助按钮' bindclick='showModal' value='>' data-modal-value='modal6' />
    <maui-cell title='带辅助和取消按钮' bindclick='showModal' value='>' data-modal-value='modal7' />
    <maui-cell title='显示关闭' bindclick='showModal' value='>' data-modal-value='modal8' />
  </maui-cell-group>

  <maui-cell-group title='自定义按钮'>
    <maui-cell title='DIY主按钮' bindclick='showModal' value='>' data-modal-value='modalDIYPrimary' />
    <maui-cell title='DIY主内容' bindclick='showModal' value='>' data-modal-value='modalDIYContent' />
  </maui-cell-group>

</view>

Page({
  data: {
    currentModal: '',
    showOverlay: false,
  },
  showModal(res) {
    this.setData({
      currentModal: res.currentTarget.dataset['modal-value'],
    });
  },
  handleClose(res) {
    this.setData({
      currentModal: '',
    });
  },

  primaryButtonTap(res) {
    this.handleClose();
    ma.showToast({
      title: '点击主要按钮',
      duration: 1000,
      mask: false,
    });
  },

  secondaryButtonTap(res) {
    this.handleClose();
    ma.showToast({
      title: '点击辅助按钮',
      duration: 1000,
      mask: false,
    });
  },

  cancelButtonTap(res) {
    this.handleClose();
    ma.showToast({
      title: '点击取消按钮',
      duration: 1000,
      mask: false,
    });
  },

  onLoad(options) {
  },
  onReady() {
  },
  onShow() {
  },
  onHide() {
  },
  onUnload() {
  },
});

{
  "navigationBarTitleText": "Modal",
  "usingComponents": {
    "maui-modal": "../../components/modal/index",
    "maui-cell-group": "../../components/cell-group/index",
    "maui-cell": "../../components/cell/index"
  }
}


button {
    margin-top: 0;
    margin-bottom: 0;
}

API

Props

参数 说明 类型 默认值
bodyClassName body 类名 String -
bodyStyle body 样式 String -
cancelButtonStyle 取消按钮样式 String -
cancelButtonText 取消按钮文本 String/Number -
closable 是否显示右上角的关闭按钮。仅在 type 为 focus 生效 Boolean -
content 内容 String -
destroyOnClose 不可见时是否卸载内容 Boolean false
maskClosable 点击蒙层是否触发 bind:close Boolean true
maskClassName 蒙层的类名 String -
maskStyle 蒙层的样式 String -
primaryButtonStyle 主按钮样式 String -
primaryButtonText 主按钮文本 String -
secondaryButtonStyle 辅助按钮样式 String -
secondaryButtonText 辅助按钮文本 String -
cancelButtonColor 取消按钮的字体颜色 String -
title 标题 String -
type 类型，可选 default(默认)、focus(强调模式) String default
visible 是否显示 Boolean -

Events

事件名 说明
bind:cancelButtonTap 取消按钮点击事件
bind:close 点击蒙层或强调模式下点击右上角关闭按钮，触发回调
bind:primaryButtonTap 主按钮点击事件
bind:secondaryButtonTap 辅助按钮点击事件

Slot

名称 说明
- 自定义content
